messages:
elaine (AM): Kicking off evidence handoff for Clearview. They want SOC2 assertion + ISO scope doc + signed pen-test letter. POC kicks Monday. @ryan (SE) can you confirm whether we can provide staging IPs and short-lived KMS creds for their scan? Also they want a ballpark for dedicated single-tenant uplift.
ryan (SE): Staging IPs = yes, but will need NAT/egress mapping. Ephemeral KMS ok in staging env — needs infra ticket for role/TTL. Dedicated uplift depends on throughput.
maria (GTM): Sales needs a sample pen-test attestation they can send legal. Do we have a template we can redline? Customer prefers upload to a secure portal, not raw email.
jules (Security): I can draft the pen-test letter. We require: signed NDA, exact test window, target IP list, and targeted systems. Note: we do not provide full SOC2 report — can share SOC2 assertion letter and redacted controls matrix.
kevin (Infra Ops): For single-tenant iso scope we need clarity: VPC peering vs dedicated host, and data residency. Peering is faster but not air-gapped. If they want on-prem style isolation we need a ticket and ~2 week lead.
elaine (AM): Timeline pressure — they asked to have evidence by Thu EOD. Is that realistic?
jules (Security): Pen-test letter draft by tomorrow noon — yes. SOC2 assertion + redacted control summary we can provide today as PDFs. Network diagram + env topology needs ops to compile, I can help.
maria (GTM): Great. For pricing, flagging @sam (Finance) — need a range to tell procurement. They asked for committed monthly numbers and an uplift for single-tenant.
sam (Finance): Rough estimate: +$10k–$15k/mo for single-tenant baseline, more if they want reserved GPUs or throughput guarantees. Will need expected RPS and token volumes to tighten. Billing add-on for KMS/ephemeral keys is small, can be included.
ryan (SE): For the POC we should supply these steps to the customer:
```
- Provide staging IP range: 35.227.100.0/24
- Whitelist scanner IPs for a 48h window
- Create ephemeral KMS role with 24h TTL
- Enable read-only audit log export to customer S3
```
Do we want to pre-provision those in a ticket?
elaine (AM): Yes please pre-provision. I'll confirm the scanner window with the customer and share the NDA. @jules once you have the letter drop it in #vendors and upload to the secure portal.
deploy-bot: Ticket created EVIDENCE-4321 -> infra (kevin) assigned.
kevin (Infra Ops): Got the ticket, will queue pre-provision tasks. If customer requests on-prem-like isolation we should schedule a short tech call to scope network egress.
elaine (AM): Thanks team — I'll loop in customer and update procurement. Will follow up here with the NDA + scanner schedule. :pray:
